The '''father''' of the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Qyzen Fess]] was a renowned [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] who [[Death/Legends|died]] at some point before [[3643 BBY]] in the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. After his death, the [[Terentatek/Legends|terentatek]] known as the [[Dusk Shadow]] moved into the area, as Fess's father had slain all of the predators in the region.
